[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/bee3e7b3-31b6-4705-8bd9-8dbf764cc92e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
At this point, the federal government looks like an organized crime unit. Like a stupid version of the Godfather. And yeah, there was corruption before Trump, and there'll be corruption after. We've gotta root it out in both parties. But right now? This is a billionaire protection racket, run by a man who sells pardons like party favors.
How else do you think George Santos got out a few weeks ago? You think Trump did that out of the kindness of his heart? Hell no. He's still teasing whether to release Diddy -- and the only reason he hasn't is probably because Diddy hasn't cut him a big enough check yet.
And I'm _furious_. I wish I was numb, but I'm not. I'm angry. And honestly, I'm glad I still feel that way. Because it's not just about the pardons.
I watched the rest of that CBS interview -- heavily edited, by the way, the same kind of editing Republicans lose their minds over when it's done to Democrats. But Trump? He's still pretending inflation doesn't exist. Still waving around a mythical health care plan he's been promising since 2015.
Meanwhile, people are barely hanging on. The job market's in the gutter. Prices are surging. The economy's weak. Eighty percent of Americans are struggling.
And what's Trump doing? Running scams. Pardoning criminals. Ripping up parts of the White House so he can build a damn ballroom for himself. He's turned the presidency into a playground for corrupt billionaires. It's obscene.
And for himself? 60% of his net worth has come in just the last ten months since taking office. Meanwhile, regular people can't cover rent, groceries, childcare. Vacations? Forget it.
And here's the thing Democrats screw up all the time: they frame everything around _survival_. But people want to _thrive_. People are exhausted from living paycheck to paycheck. They want to live their lives, support their kids, and give them more than just the basics.
Instead, we've got a president telling people to buy fewer presents for their kids while he's throwing a Great Gatsby-themed party at the White House this weekend -- with actual flappers in champagne glasses -- while the rest of us watch from the sidelines.
* * *

Paid subscribers make it possible--just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/bee3e7b3-31b6-4705-8bd9-8dbf764cc92e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/bee3e7b3-31b6-4705-8bd9-8dbf764cc92e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Then he goes on _60 Minutes_ and brags about pardoning someone he's never heard of. Talks up a health care plan that doesn't exist. Lies about grocery prices being lower than they were ten months ago. Anyone managing a household budget knows better. Everything's more expensive, paychecks don't stretch, and people are drowning.
Trump's a skilled liar, but he can't gaslight people about the cost of living. This is daily reality for millions. And Democrats learned that the hard way last cycle. Now it's Trump's turn -- tomorrow, in New Jersey, Virginia, and beyond. And again in two years, when voters boot the GOP from power.
Meanwhile, Mike Johnson and House Republicans haven't worked in 45 days. Nothing to lower grocery prices, nothing to help you buy a home, nothing to stop the shutdown. Nothing. You or I skipped work for 45 days, we'd be fired.
And now the polling is catching up. CNN's latest today has Trump at 37% approval, 67% disapproval. The con is unraveling. People are pissed. Republicans are hedging. They're scared.
That's why they're gerrymandering the hell out of every red state -- trying to squeeze out a few more votes before the blue wave crashes. That's why Marjorie Taylor Greene is breaking ranks. She's going on _The View_ , of all places, to talk about how Republicans have no health care plan and how Trump's wrecking the economy.
You think she's doing that out of some moral awakening? Come on. She's seen the polling. She knows Trump's toxic. And she's trying to get ahead of the fallout -- while the rest of them are too scared to piss off their base, too cowardly to even show up to work, while 40 million Americans can't access their SNAP benefits.
A lot of people gave Trump a shot at the start of this term. Even if they didn't like him, they hoped he'd deliver. They needed him to help with basic economic survival. But now? He's done the exact opposite--everything is worse.
People aren't apathetic anymore. They're _angry_. They're in the streets, screaming _no kings_ , fed up with being lied to, stolen from, ignored by a government that doesn't work for them.
This isn't left vs. right anymore. It's _us_ vs. the people trying to sell off the country like it's their personal yard sale. And I'll be damned if we forever hand the People's House to a man who treats it like a luxury resort for the ultra-rich -- on our dime.

Imagine if Joe Biden admitted to selling pardons like this. | | | Nov 3 | | | | | | | | | | | | Without a doubt, the biggest story in the country today should be Donald Trump admitting on CBS last night that he has no idea who he's pardoning. He let a convicted crypto fraudster walk free and then, on national television, straight-up said he only did it because his sons told him to. Let that sink in. Can you imagine the reaction if Joe Biden said he pardoned someone because Hunter told him to? If Biden blindly freed a scammer based solely on his son's recommendation -- no due diligence, no second thought -- conservative media would be frothing at the mouth. Republicans would launch twenty investigations before lunch. But with Trump? Shrugs. Silence from the MAGA influencers. Let's be clear: this wasn't a Freudian slip. It wasn't a mistake. It was a confession. Trump freed a crypto kingpin who pled guilty to fraud -- just like he pardoned cop-beaters from January 6th, just like he pardoned drug dealers, sex offenders, and white-collar crooks -- because he's likely getting paid, one way or another, in this massive corruption scheme. This crypto guy didn't get pardoned for fun. He got out because Trump's kids are knee-deep in the same crypto scam, raking in billions. To Trump and his inner circle, the presidency isn't a job or a responsibility. It's a money pipeline. And by admitting he doesn't even know who he's pardoning, Trump's telling us exactly who he is: a puppet for profit, a vessel for other people's corruption. At this point, the federal government looks like an organized crime unit. Like a stupid version of the Godfather. And yeah, there was corruption before Trump, and there'll be corruption after. We've gotta root it out in both parties. But right now? This is a billionaire protection racket, run by a man who sells pardons like party favors. How else do you think George Santos got out a few weeks ago? You think Trump did that out of the kindness of his heart? Hell no. He's still teasing whether to release Diddy -- and the only reason he hasn't is probably because Diddy hasn't cut him a big enough check yet. And I'm furious. I wish I was numb, but I'm not. I'm angry. And honestly, I'm glad I still feel that way. Because it's not just about the pardons. I watched the rest of that CBS interview -- heavily edited, by the way, the same kind of editing Republicans lose their minds over when it's done to Democrats. But Trump? He's still pretending inflation doesn't exist. Still waving around a mythical health care plan he's been promising since 2015. Meanwhile, people are barely hanging on. The job market's in the gutter. Prices are surging. The economy's weak. Eighty percent of Americans are struggling. And what's Trump doing? Running scams. Pardoning criminals. Ripping up parts of the White House so he can build a damn ballroom for himself. He's turned the presidency into a playground for corrupt billionaires. It's obscene. And for himself? 60% of his net worth has come in just the last ten months since taking office. Meanwhile, regular people can't cover rent, groceries, childcare. Vacations? Forget it. And here's the thing Democrats screw up all the time: they frame everything around survival. But people want to thrive. People are exhausted from living paycheck to paycheck. They want to live their lives, support their kids, and give them more than just the basics. Instead, we've got a president telling people to buy fewer presents for their kids while he's throwing a Great Gatsby-themed party at the White House this weekend -- with actual flappers in champagne glasses -- while the rest of us watch from the sidelines. * Then he goes on 60 Minutes and brags about pardoning someone he's never heard of. Talks up a health care plan that doesn't exist. Lies about grocery prices being lower than they were ten months ago. Anyone managing a household budget knows better. Everything's more expensive, paychecks don't stretch, and people are drowning. Trump's a skilled liar, but he can't gaslight people about the cost of living. This is daily reality for millions. And Democrats learned that the hard way last cycle. Now it's Trump's turn -- tomorrow, in New Jersey, Virginia, and beyond. And again in two years, when voters boot the GOP from power. Meanwhile, Mike Johnson and House Republicans haven't worked in 45 days. Nothing to lower grocery prices, nothing to help you buy a home, nothing to stop the shutdown. Nothing. You or I skipped work for 45 days, we'd be fired. And now the polling is catching up. CNN's latest today has Trump at 37% approval, 67% disapproval. The con is unraveling. People are pissed. Republicans are hedging. They're scared. That's why they're gerrymandering the hell out of every red state -- trying to squeeze out a few more votes before the blue wave crashes. That's why Marjorie Taylor Greene is breaking ranks. She's going on The View , of all places, to talk about how Republicans have no health care plan and how Trump's wrecking the economy. You think she's doing that out of some moral awakening? Come on. She's seen the polling. She knows Trump's toxic. And she's trying to get ahead of the fallout -- while the rest of them are too scared to piss off their base, too cowardly to even show up to work, while 40 million Americans can't access their SNAP benefits. A lot of people gave Trump a shot at the start of this term. Even if they didn't like him, they hoped he'd deliver. They needed him to help with basic economic survival. But now? He's done the exact opposite--everything is worse. People aren't apathetic anymore. They're angry. They're in the streets, screaming no kings , fed up with being lied to, stolen from, ignored by a government that doesn't work for them. This isn't left vs. right anymore. It's us vs. the people trying to sell off the country like it's their personal yard sale. And I'll be damned if we forever hand the People's House to a man who treats it like a luxury resort for the ultra-rich -- on our dime. Tomorrow, thousands of New Jerseyans will head to the polls to make their final decision in a race that will determine the future of our state.
I know most campaigns would take this opportunity to maximize their donations and squeeze every last dollar from their supporters – but I’m not going to do that.

Friend - I'm sitting down to write to you today with a heart full of gratitude and a spirit that's more fired up than ever. Since announcing my run for Governor of Virginia, the outpouring of support has been nothing short of incredible.

I've received thousands of messages from folks all across the Commonwealth - It’s humbling to have the prayers and support of so many patriots.

As a Marine and a proud conservative, I know that I have the experience and the conviction to lead our great Commonwealth forward. I'm committed to protecting the promise of Virginia, where every child can get a world-class education, every business can thrive, and every family can live in safety and prosperity.

But I didn't expect the rush of enthusiasm that's swept across our campaign. _**From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being part of this movement.**_ Your encouragement, your volunteer hours, and your generous financial support are the fuel that will propel us ever forward.

Now, I need to ask for your help again. We have a long and challenging road ahead, and it's going to take every ounce of our energy and resources to win. _**[_**Can you chip in today to help us keep the momentum going? Every donation, no matter how small, brings us one step closer to victory.**_](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bqIr/?__vbtrk=MzMwNTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzMwNTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_

Together, we can do this. Together, we will make Virginia the land of freedom, opportunity, and prosperity that we know it can be.

Sincerely,
Winsome Earle-Sears

clean_body: I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. | Fellow patriot — You may already know me – some of you know me and my story well. But I want to take this opportunity to reintroduce myself and share some exciting news. My name is Mark Lamb — I’m a husband, father, God-fearing American, and the proud former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. After much prayer and reflection with my family, I’ve made a huge decision: I am officially running for Congress in Arizona’s 5th District! This isn’t about ambition — it’s about service. I’ve seen what happens when leaders lack courage and conviction, and I refuse to sit by while feckless politicians and bureaucrats fail our nation’s families. I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. Before I go any further, I want to thank Congressman Andy Biggs for his years of service to AZ-5 and wish him well in his decision to step down from this seat and run for Governor of Arizona. Andy has always fought hard for conservative values, and you can trust that I will do the same. You know me, and you know my record. As Sheriff, I spent years on the frontlines — battling the fentanyl epidemic, fighting cartel violence spilling over our borders, rescuing children from trafficking rings, and holding gang members and criminals accountable. Every day, I put on my badge and carried the responsibility of keeping our communities safe. I’ve seen families ripped apart by crime and drugs, and I’ve felt that pain personally. I’ve seen firsthand the devastating effects of rising crime and failing leadership. I won’t stand by while career politicians in Washington make excuses, play politics, and leave families unprotected. Our liberty, our safety, and our freedom are not guaranteed by silence — they are defended through action. I will fight in Congress for the same principles I’ve lived by as Sheriff: personal responsibility, faith, courage, and an unwavering commitment to the people I serve. I will stand up to the woke left, to the weak political establishment, and to anyone who puts politics above the safety of our communities. This fight will not be easy. Washington isn’t used to someone who tells it like it is, someone who’s willing to get their hands dirty and put people over politics. But that’s exactly what I intend to do — for Arizona families, for our law enforcement, and for our Constitution. I’m ready to step up and bring real leadership to Congress, but I can’t do it alone. Every contribution — big or small — sends a message: that hard-working families won’t be ignored, that our freedoms matter, and that courage still counts in America. I’m ready, fellow patriot. Are you with me? For God, Family, and Country, Mark Lamb Republican for Congress, AZ-5 P.S. I want to make it clear that the outpouring of support you’ve shown me and my wife, Janel, in the past factored into our decision to make this run. As Sheriff, I couldn’t have accomplished what I did without my deputies, and I won’t be able to succeed in this fight without you. Thank you! | Peter,
In the not so distant future....
"Breaking news" flashes across the television screen. The anchor's smile is rehearsed, her voice steady--reading a script stamped with the White House seal. Anything else would be a crime.
"President Trump has secured another term--winning in a landslide after sweeping Pennsylvania."
No one is shocked anymore.
After MAGA seized control of PA's Supreme Court, they gerrymandered Democrats out of existence. Election laws were rewritten. Abortion was banned in Pennsylvania and then nationwide. Dissenters were prosecuted. Journalists fled or fell silent. And the birthplace of American democracy became its graveyard.
Across America, empty courthouses stand as monuments to a democracy that didn't fight hard enough to save itself.
That's the future America we are fighting to prevent and it all comes down to what happens tomorrow.
This Tuesday's Pennsylvania Supreme Court election decides whether MAGA's judicial takeover begins the dismantling of our democracy--or whether we draw the line here, before the nightmare takes hold.
Defend our Courts is throwing everything we have into this fight--last-minute ads, volunteer shifts, door knocks--but we're running out of resources fast.

clean_body: I’m demanding a full accounting of how much taxpayer money is being spent on these politically-motivated deployments. | | | | Not only is the National Guard not wanted or needed in Portland, but Trump's politically motivated deployments to cities nationwide are wasting millions of taxpayer dollars. These deployments serve no legitimate purpose beyond tightening his authoritarian grip and intimidating communities that dare to dissent. That's why I'm demanding a full accounting of how much taxpayer money is being spent on these deployments. The American people deserve full transparency regarding how their tax dollars are used — especially when the federal government deploys military personnel on U.S. soil without a declared emergency or a request from state officials. Trump's promise to send troops to Portland has stalled in federal court, but we can't assume the threat has passed. Every dollar wasted on these unnecessary deployments is a dollar not going toward the services and support our communities actually need. I'll continue to push for accountability and transparency. Our democracy depends on it. | | | Peter, Earlier this year, Trump and Texas Republicans redrew congressional maps to give themselves **_five extra seats_** before voters even had a say. It was a blatant power grab designed to tilt the next Congress in their favor. And it’s not just a problem for Texas. When one state rigs its congressional map, it affects every election across the country — every bill that passes, every right we fight for. **That’s why this Tuesday, Californians are being asked to vote YES on Proposition 50, the Election Rigging Response Act.** If approved, Prop 50 would redraw California’s congressional map to create five new districts where working people have a fair chance to elect representatives who actually represent them — and nullify the election‐rigging power grab by Texas Republicans that was designed to steal seats before voters even cast a ballot. But we can’t win this fight without you, Peter.**Tonight and tomorrow, California Working Families Party is hosting national phone banks to turn out the vote for Prop 50. clean_body: | | | Peter, Earlier this year, Trump and Texas Republicans redrew congressional maps to give themselves five extra seats before voters even had a say. It was a blatant power grab designed to tilt the next Congress in their favor. And it’s not just a problem for Texas. When one state rigs its congressional map, it affects every election across the country — every bill that passes, every right we fight for. That’s why this Tuesday, Californians are being asked to vote YES on Proposition 50, the Election Rigging Response Act. If approved, Prop 50 would redraw California’s congressional map to create five new districts where working people have a fair chance to elect representatives who actually represent them — and nullify the election‐rigging power grab by Texas Republicans that was designed to steal seats before voters even cast a ballot. But we can’t win this fight without you, Peter.Tonight and tomorrow, California Working Families Party is hosting national phone banks to turn out the vote for Prop 50. In just one volunteer shift, you could reach hundreds of Californians and help protect democracy nationwide. This isn’t just about lines on a map, Peter. It’s about protecting voting rights, defending reproductive freedom, and building a government that works for working families — not billionaires, extremists, or politicians trying to rig the system. What Californians do tomorrow will affect the entire country. This election is expected to be close, and we can’t leave it to chance. In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? (If you were to ask our very good dog Zeke, he’d tell you my best role is "reliable treat source.") I decided to run for Governor because I want a Colorado where our kids get the best possible start in life, are prepared and able to build their lives here, can afford to live here, and our families can truly thrive. As your attorney general, my north star is: _Always stand up for Colorado._ **I’m proud that we have fought and won against Big Pharma, irresponsible corporate actors like Dollar General, and the lawless Trump administration.** We’ve taken them all to court — including 41 times and counting against Trump. subject: A quick thank you, and a gut check
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1224%2E251025%2EzAGV8r ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1224%2E251025%2EzAGV8r ]Abdul for US Senate

First off, thank you.

Peter, because of
this grassroots team’s
support, we hit our October fundraising goal and kicked off the first
month of Q4 strong.

That means we’re entering the election year with real momentum. Every
dollar we raise helps strengthen our people-powered campaign and stand up
to corporate PACs, AIPAC, and the would-be oligarchs.

So truly, thank you. We couldn’t do this without you.

But I also want to take a moment for a gut check.

As I write this, the government shutdown is still dragging on. This is all
because MAGA Republicans are hellbent on kicking millions of Americans off
their healthcare and hiking insurance premiums for millions more.

Federal workers are missing their paychecks.

ICE continues to disappear people without due process.

Meanwhile, the man sitting in the White House is building a new $300
million ballroom.

It’s the perfect metaphor for what’s wrong with Washington: while the
powerful party, working people are struggling just to get by.

Things are bleak for many reasons right now, but I’ll be honest, I still
feel hope.

I see it in every conversation on the trail, in the volunteers giving
their time to support our campaign, and in the small-dollar donors keeping
this movement alive.

I see it in campaigns like ours, and incredible leaders running for and
winning offices across the country who are proving that when we organize
together, we can still move mountains.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/survey/hope-survey/?source=em20251103-1204&akid=1224%2E251025%2EzAGV8r ]What’s giving you hope right now,
Peter?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/survey/hope-survey/?source=em20251103-1204&akid=1224%2E251025%2EzAGV8r ]Share your source of hope ››

I’d love to hear what’s keeping your spirits high. Because even in the
toughest moments, we’ve got to remind each other that there are better
times ahead — and that there’s still plenty of good worth fighting for.

In solidarity,

Abdul

Blue!

Fellow Patriot,

As a career law enforcement officer, I felt the lack of support from left-wing politicians day in and day out.

In too many cases, WE were even their targets.

It’s no wonder that we’ve seen a _**1000% surge in violence against federal law enforcement agents**_ this year while they’re working to enforce our nation’s laws and keep our communities safe.

**Law enforcement officers should never have to apologize for doing their jobs** , yet they’re forced to do so every single day.

Fellow American,

My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. **I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. _This is my story._**

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do.

| Peter,
The 2025 Pennsylvania Supreme Court election has become the penultimate set piece battle of Trump's 2nd term.
On the line is control of key swing state Pennsylvania and its 19 electoral college votes. If MAGA's electoral coup succeeds they become the umpire for all elections held in PA and they can rewrite the rule book to ensure Democrats never win PA again. This is how Trump gets his 3rd term.
For months Democrats had been on track to lose this election but over the past few days the tide has turned. Obama, DNC Chair Ken Martin, and PA Governor Shapiro, have come in massively to turn out the vote. Millions of Democratic small dollar donors are flooding the race with millions. For the first time in this election Democrats are on the offensive.
MAGA is panicking which is why last night President Trump took to Truth social to beg his voters to show up and vote down Pennsylvania's "woke justices."

If MAGA's electoral coup succeeds they become the umpire for all elections held in PA and they can rewrite the rule book to ensure Democrats never win PA again. This is how Trump gets his 3rd term. For months Democrats had been on track to lose this election but over the past few days the tide has turned. Obama, DNC Chair Ken Martin, and PA Governor Shapiro, have come in massively to turn out the vote. Millions of Democratic small dollar donors are flooding the race with millions. For the first time in this election Democrats are on the offensive. MAGA is panicking which is why last night President Trump took to Truth social to beg his voters to show up and vote down Pennsylvania's "woke justices." | == | | | | When Trump tells his base to vote they listen. This will give MAGA a massive turnout boost. There is no doubt about it. But we can mitigate its impact. Last week, Defend our Courts placed a massive last minute $500k TV and digital ad buy to help spread the message that the only way to protect abortion in Pennsylvania is by voting Yes. It was money we technically didn't have (we owe nearly $500k to vendors). While we were able to recoup that money over the weekend, Trump's intervention means we once again need to spend our entire warchest, this time on rapid response texts and hyper targeted digital ads to turnout our voters, and once again we will need to quickly recoup that money to remain financially solvent. Peter,
The Virginia governor’s race is razor-thin, with RealClearPolitics showing just a **3% difference** between the candidates in the latest poll. That margin could be as high as **95,700 votes** or as low as **82,800**. The difference between godly leadership and policies that ignore biblical values.

With **5.81 million registered voters** in Virginia, turnout on **November 4** could range from **2.76 to 3.19 million** , depending on whether voters show up like they did in **2017 (47.6%)** or **2021 (54.9%)**. Will they be informed? Will they be guided by faith?

My Faith Votes is focused on reaching **low-propensity Christian voters**. Those who are already registered, but don’t vote consistently, especially in off-year elections like this one. Many simply need a reminder, a reason, and a resource to act. That’s where we come in.

Thanks to our army of Action Partners, we’re already sending over **112,000 letters** to low-propensity Christian voters in Virginia and more are being written every day.

_But we must do more._

**Text messaging has been proven to boost turnout.** We want to follow up with those receiving letters and reach even more Christian voters across Virginia with a simple, powerful message and a link to our **Candidate Fact Sheet.**

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

body:
I went to New Jersey this weekend to help a fellow veteran — and a great Democrat — win.

| |
---
Friend, This past weekend, I headed to New Jersey to knock on doors for my friend and fellow veteran Mikie Sherrill, who is running in one of the most competitive gubernatorial races in the country. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118597824/580265359/2090747700?refcode=251103_sm_ms_img1&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWY0MzlkNS0wMmI5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fm5SpvViPJyDMf9l5-ccBU79NdpJDBImr7cJYMKzRLY=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118597825/580265360/2090747700?refcode=251103_sm_ms_img2&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWY0MzlkNS0wMmI5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fm5SpvViPJyDMf9l5-ccBU79NdpJDBImr7cJYMKzRLY=) I first met Mikie in 2018 when she was running for Congress. Hearing her story, learning about her service background, and understanding the incredible impact she had already had on the lives around her made it a no-brainer to invest in her 100% through my Serve America PAC. We helped raise hundreds of thousands of dollars for her in that race, and I have continued to support her and partner with her in the last few years. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118597826/580265361/2090747700?refcode=251103_sm_ms_img3&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWY0MzlkNS0wMmI5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fm5SpvViPJyDMf9l5-ccBU79NdpJDBImr7cJYMKzRLY=) Mikie and I share a lot in common. We both served our country in uniform — she as a Navy helicopter pilot and I as a Marine infantry officer. We both came home determined to continue serving by rolling up our sleeves and fighting for a better future here at home. Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are pulling out all the stops to flip New Jersey red. They’ve endorsed Mikie’s opponent, flooded the state with dark money, and weaponized government power to attack her personally. But Mikie’s not backing down, and neither am I. I’ve seen firsthand how much it matters when Democrats show up for one another. We flipped more than two dozen red seats through Serve America by recruiting veterans and service-driven leaders who put country before politics. When we work together, we win. It's as simple as that. Mikie’s fight in New Jersey isn’t just about one state. It’s about whether we have the courage to stand up to Trump’s authoritarianism, defend our democracy, and prove that integrity and service still mean something in American politics. **[That’s the fight I’m in, too — in Massachusetts and across the country. If you’re ready to help us elect leaders who put people first and country above party, I hope you’ll chip in today to help power this campaign for a new generation of leadership forward.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118597827/580265362/2090747700?refcode=251103_sm_ms_l1&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWY0MzlkNS0wMmI5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fm5SpvViPJyDMf9l5-ccBU79NdpJDBImr7cJYMKzRLY=)** **[CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118597828/580265363/1375639745?refcode=251103_sm_ms_b1&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWY0MzlkNS0wMmI5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fm5SpvViPJyDMf9l5-ccBU79NdpJDBImr7cJYMKzRLY=)** Thank you for being part of this movement. — Seth

Hearing her story, learning about her service background, and understanding the incredible impact she had already had on the lives around her made it a no-brainer to invest in her 100% through my Serve America PAC. We helped raise hundreds of thousands of dollars for her in that race, and I have continued to support her and partner with her in the last few years. = Mikie and I share a lot in common. We both served our country in uniform — she as a Navy helicopter pilot and I as a Marine infantry officer. We both came home determined to continue serving by rolling up our sleeves and fighting for a better future here at home. Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are pulling out all the stops to flip New Jersey red. They’ve endorsed Mikie’s opponent, flooded the state with dark money, and weaponized government power to attack her personally. But Mikie’s not backing down, and neither am I. I’ve seen firsthand how much it matters when Democrats show up for one another. We flipped more than two dozen red seats through Serve America by recruiting veterans and service-driven leaders who put country before politics. When we work together, we win. It's as simple as that. Mikie’s fight in New Jersey isn’t just about one state. It’s about whether we have the courage to stand up to Trump’s authoritarianism, defend our democracy, and prove that integrity and service still mean something in American politics. = = Thank you for being part of this movement. — Seth | | | ---|---|--- About Seth Moulton Seth Moulton is a father, a husband, a Marine, and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. body:
[1]Powered By People

I just got back from the road last night and want to tell you all about
it.

I left El Paso on Wednesday to lead a candidate recruitment rally in Fort
Worth, which happens to sit in one of the last competitive large counties
in Texas. The rest of the big ones in Texas — Travis (home to Austin),
Harris (Houston), Bexar (San Antonio), and Dallas — are all strong
Democratic majority counties.

But Tarrant County, which has over two million people and includes Fort
Worth, is a true toss-up. It had been reliably Republican for decades
before I won a slim majority there in 2018. Joe Biden won it in 2020. But
in the following election cycles it swung back to the GOP. Victories here
are tough, hard-fought, and never permanent.

Bottom line: without Tarrant County it will be impossible for Democrats to
win political power in Texas.

So on a chilly autumn evening, I gathered with a couple hundred people on
the outdoor patio of the Rusty Nickel brewhouse to talk about the
importance of running for a place on the ballot. County Commissioner,
Constable, State House, State Senate, U.S. Congress. My theory of the
case: if we field a strong candidate for every available office, we have a
much stronger chance of winning county-wide, as well as winning statewide.
I saw that in 2018 — part of the reason we carried Tarrant and got so
close against Cruz was the full ballot of quality Democrats that were
running with me.

After I made my pitch and we answered questions from prospective
candidates, 16 people raised their hands to run for office in Tarrant
County. A great start!

The next day we were in McKinney in Collin County, one of the fastest
growing counties in America (pop. 1.2 million). Same general trend — we
got within four points in 2020, but the gap has grown some since then. At
our recruiting event at a bar called “Elysium,” 22 people said they were
interested in running for office after we made our pitch. More progress.

Saturday I was in Brazos County, smaller and more rural (pop. 250,000) and
a lot redder electorally. And yet, if Democrats get on the ballot, then
we’ll have candidates around whom we can organize, values that voters can
watch us fight for, and more votes going both to these new candidates and
all the way up to our nominees for Senate and Governor too.

We closed the week in Waco on Sunday (McLennan County, pop. 270,000),
another place where we’ve historically struggled to get Democrats on the
ballot. More than 150 people packed the Southern Roots brewery to talk
about the stakes for 2026 and then commit themselves to action. Many
signed up to learn more about running for office and nearly half joined
Powered by People to volunteer to register and turn out the voters who
will power these new candidates’ campaigns.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251103.2FCFNW&refcode=ema20251103-240440&t=1003&akid=240440%2E444211%2EHJitjC ]Beto at Rallies

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251103.2FCFNW&refcode=ema20251103-240440&t=1004&akid=240440%2E444211%2EHJitjC ]Beto at Rallies

I told them: “We are tempted to despair as we watch what’s happening to
this country. Some might even lose hope. But we can’t let that happen. We
must take action. It’s the antidote to despair. It’s the key to victory.
It’s hope in motion.”

Tarrant. Collin. Brazos. McLennan. All currently “Red” counties. But if we
show up, fight on every front, for every position on the ballot, concede
nothing and work until we win, these counties may hold the key to big
Democratic victories in 2026.

Thanks for keeping me on the road so that we can do this important
organizing work. We’re bringing our fellow Texans into the most important
election in our lives by giving them ways to take action. Running for
office. Volunteering for Powered by People. Whatever it takes, we are
committed to doing the work.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Could you send a donation to the Arizona Food Bank Network?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Hey everybody, Mark Kelly here.
I sent an email on Saturday to see if anyone could afford to chip in to the Arizona Food Bank Network to help the people going without food because of Trump’s attempts to cut off SNAP benefits. Thanks to the people who donated, a ton of families have food on the dinner table. I’m really grateful.
But this crisis won’t end until Donald Trump decides to act like the President of the United States and negotiate a deal that doesn’t screw over millions of American families.
Trump loves talking about dealmaking and peacemaking all over the world, but he’s refused to make a deal with actual Americans to stop this shutdown and keep health care premiums from spiking. He acts tough, but he’s weak. Letting kids go hungry isn’t the act of a tough guy. It’s something a bully would do.
[**But enough about Trump. People still need help. Can you make a donation to the Arizona Food Bank Network today so people can keep getting fed? Anything goes a long way.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-afbn/.YDmKuh&refcode=em251103-1-f&t=1&akid=6237%2E6688874%2EI1mmfS)

Thanks so much.
Mark

MAGA wants absolute power. They want to crush opposition. They want to clear the path for Trump’s total takeover.
**And to do that, MAGA needs Jon Ossoff defeated and gone.**
They’re going to do absolutely anything, use every dirty trick in the book to replace Jon with a Trump loyalist and MAGA rubber stamp.

This week, Christopher Newport University released their final poll of our race for Governor.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: My weekend
body:
Peter, my goal is to spend many weekends out on the campaign trail, meeting with North Carolinians to hear out their concerns and to discuss our shared goals for this state and our nation — not worrying over our fundraising numbers with my team.

Unfortunately, last month we raised a bit less online than we’d hoped for.

Now, I’m not telling you that the sky is falling. Our campaign is still strong. We’re going to keep working hard to build the infrastructure to win, and we are truly grateful to the folks who’ve stepped up to provide the resources allowing us to do just that.

But our shortfall does mean that we can’t enact the most aggressive plans we’d put together for November. We have to stay within the limits of our budget, and given my opponent’s recent polling gains, we’re concerned about losing the momentum we need to stay ahead.

In a race this competitive, we have to do everything we can to avoid a single misstep. That’s why I am personally asking for a small contribution of any size today to help get our team back on track. Please click here to give whatever is right for you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cvf_email_fr]

Thanks very much,

Roy Cooper

clean_body: Peter, my goal is to spend many weekends out on the campaign trail, meeting with North Carolinians to hear out their concerns and to discuss our shared goals for this state and our nation — not worrying over our fundraising numbers with my team. Unfortunately, last month we raised a bit less online than we’d hoped for. Now, I’m not telling you that the sky is falling. Our campaign is still strong. We’re going to keep working hard to build the infrastructure to win, and we are truly grateful to the folks who’ve stepped up to provide the resources allowing us to do just that. But our shortfall does mean that we can’t enact the most aggressive plans we’d put together for November. We have to stay within the limits of our budget, and given my opponent’s recent polling gains, we’re concerned about losing the momentum we need to stay ahead. In a race this competitive, we have to do everything we can to avoid a single misstep. That’s why I am personally asking for a small contribution of any size today to help get our team back on track. Please click here to give whatever is right for you. [] Thanks very much, Roy Cooper Contact us [info@roycooper.com] |

clean_body: , I'm writing to you today with a thought I wanted to share with you. As I reflect on how far we've come in this campaign, I've realized what my biggest regret would be. I hate asking for donations; it's one of the worst parts of any campaign. But the support from you and so many patriots across the country are the key to winning this CRUCIAL race. So the fact is, if I've realize that if we came all this way, and I could look back knowing that I could've done more, that would be my biggest regret. I know that I would always regret if I hadn't taken a chance to ask for your help when it matters most. I hadn't sent this email, I would regret not giving you the opportunity to stand with me against the liberal agenda that's threatening our nation. I would regret not giving you the chance to make a difference in the fight for our values, our freedom, and our Commonwealth. support will help me continue to fight for what we believe in, and it will give us the resources we need to take on my Democrat opponent and her liberal megadonors. I know that I'm not alone in this fight. I know that there are thousands of conservatives like you who are willing to stand up for what's right. And I know that together, we can make a real difference. But I need your help to make it happen. I need your contribution to help me and my team ensure we have the resources we need to spread our message and win this CLOSE and CRITICAL electionI refuse to look back and regret not doing everything I could to defend our values. Please don't sit on the sidelines, Peter! Sincerely,Winsome Earle-Sears| . Marine. Mom. Small Business Owner. Lieutenant Governor. I'm Winsome Earle-Sears, and I've held many titles in my life. Each one hasn't been a cakewalk, but I like a challenge. I've tried to show my daughters that what you can accomplish is not decided by the color of your skin or where you were born.Sure, a silver spoon would've made it easier, but I've found a helping hand from your community means so much more. ** This will be another challenge, but with you on my side, I know I can do this. | Paid for by Winsome for Governor Neither military info nor photographs of Winsome Earle-Sears in uniform imply endorsement of Winsome Earle-Sears by the Department of Defense or its particular military departments. Peter,

The 2026 general election is just one year from today, and the Democratic
primaries will happen even sooner.

In addition to supporting our incumbents in their re-election races
against AIPAC and Crypto, Justice Democrats has already endorsed four new
U.S. House candidates to challenge out-of-touch, establishment Democratic
incumbents standing in the way of progress, including:

* Donavan McKinney in Michigan’s 13th district
* Angela Gonzalez-Torres in California’s 34th district
* Justin J. Pearson in Tennessee’s 9th district
* Cori Bush in Missouri’s 1st district

All four of these progressive leaders:

* Come from working-class backgrounds and understand the struggles of
their communities first-hand;
* Reject contributions from AIPAC, and support an arms embargo to end
the genocide in Palestine;
* Refuse corporate PAC money, because they will only answer to the
people, not the wealthiest few;
* Demand bold solutions like Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, a
living wage, affordable housing, and taxing the millionaires and
billionaires;
* Are ready and willing to fight Donald Trump, MAGA Republicans, and the
rise of fascism with everything they’ve got.

Over the next few months, our establishment opponents — fueled by
megadonors and corporate PACs like AIPAC — will no doubt begin attacking

We need the resources to go up against them and win, but the truth is, our

subject: The impact of the shutdown is only growing
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q4-2025?refcode=em-header [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q4-2025?refcode=em-header]
Peter,

I want to extend my gratitude for your support in October. With your help, we met our online fundraising goal and are in a good spot as we look to start the midterm election year with strength.

We cannot ignore what is happening on House Republicans’ watch. As we enter the second month of the government shutdown, my GOP colleagues are nowhere to be found – they are refusing to meet with Democrats to come to an agreement on protecting healthcare and ending the shutdown.

The impacts are disastrous for millions of families across Southern California and the country who rely on food assistance and are now going without aid. And instead of pushing for an end to the shutdown, President Trump is spending millions on a White House ballroom and hosting extravagant parties.

The difference could not be more clear: My fellow Democrats and I are ready to work, and the Republican majority could not care less. My mission will always be working for CA-27 to put an end to the chaos.

Thank you for being with me in the fight,

George

Singer-songwriter Tish Hyman **[sparked viral outrage](https://substack.com/redirect/fb4a0363-c1d9-4a27-9ffe-b891ff2a536f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after claiming Los Angeles Gold's Gym terminated her membership for complaining about a man who repeatedly **[entered the women's locker](https://substack.com/redirect/0e145625-7a39-4959-bfbb-8828790af7a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** room and allegedly harassed her, despite multiple written complaints from female members that staff ignored until the confrontation escalated.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/bfac60fe-9d40-428e-a0ab-52cce19ed7ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Hyman said** the man followed her into the women's locker room at Gold's Gym Beverly Center and called her a derogatory name, causing her to flee in fear and scream for help, with police ultimately escorting both individuals from the facility before gym management revoked her membership alongside his removal.
* **She revealed** that she and several other women had filed multiple written complaints with gym staff about the same man harassing them in the women's locker room, but the facility took no action until Hyman publicly confronted the situation and "made noise" about the ongoing safety concerns.
* **Hyman launched** a boycott campaign demanding Gold's Gym and new owner EoS Fitness implement stronger safety measures and consider creating designated transgender or gender-neutral locker rooms, as her viral post reignited national debate over women's privacy rights and safety in gender-based spaces, though neither company has issued a public statement on the incident.

* * *
# Trump's 60 Minutes sit down: "I see good things happening"
President Donald Trump went on **[CBS's 60 minutes Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/c64b1781-c266-4a13-b9bd-089ca7c3f78e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, reminding host Norah O'Donnell that the network was forced to pay him substantial money after losing a lawsuit over their deceptive editing of Kamala Harris' disastrous responses during the 2024 campaign.
* **Trump secured a $16 million** settlement from CBS and Paramount in July after suing the network for election interference, alleging they deliberately edited Harris' incoherent answer about Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to make her appear more competent by airing different versions of her response on separate broadcasts.
* **The president praised CBS 's new direction** under Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss during the interview, telling O'Donnell he sees "good things happening in the news" and calling Weiss "a great new leader," though his pointed remarks about the settlement payment did not air during Sunday night's broadcast and only appeared in the extended YouTube version.
* **Trump also warned** that he would find it difficult to send federal money to New York City if Democratic socialist candidate Zohran Mamdani wins the mayoral race, calling Mamdani a communist and saying that between "a bad Democrat and a communist, I'm going to pick the bad Democrat all the time" while discussing the race with O'Donnell.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/244ef1d6-fefa-44b4-8c57-817c2890b350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
# **Democrats push California redistricting power grab as rural voters push back**
California voters head to the polls Tuesday to decide **[Proposition 50](https://substack.com/redirect/fd2d0b3a-e277-4292-9336-634d38339df5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a controversial ballot measure that would allow state lawmakers to redraw congressional district lines in what Republicans call a brazen Democratic attempt to flip additional House seats and potentially reclaim majority control in 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a150880-a432-4229-99f1-40776d8a921d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Generational Farmers ' Fear:** Fourth-generation Central Valley farmer Jenny Holtermann warned the proposed redistricting plan would deliberately carve out Republican areas and shift them into Democratic districts, silencing rural agricultural communities that have long defined the region's political character and saying "that's not what the Central Valley is."
* **Rallying Voters:** The California Farm Bureau joined opposition to Proposition 50, with rural voters expressing concern that urban-dominated Sacramento politicians would further diminish their political influence by redrawing boundaries to favor Democratic candidates in traditionally conservative farming regions.
* **The Defense:** Fresno County Democratic Party Vice Chair Lonny Johnson defended the redistricting effort by claiming Republicans in Texas, North Carolina and Missouri gerrymandered their own maps without voter input, arguing California Democrats must "fight this" or allow the GOP to maintain House control and leave no check on the Trump administration. The reasoning is clear, and clearly stated that the efforts are fighting fire with fire, combatting earlier Texas redistricting and by doing it themselves, with Gavin Newsom calling it "the most **[transparent and democratic redistricting](https://substack.com/redirect/b3703f7c-b33e-4e69-9ab4-e2e0c4b525b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that's ever been done in the United States of America."

* * *
# **Mamdani 's youth advantage fades with election 1 day away, Cuomo sees surges**
**[Younger voters dominated](https://substack.com/redirect/837314f5-f677-40c7-b2d3-dd08c4d458c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/837314f5-f677-40c7-b2d3-dd08c4d458c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)early voting in New York City's mayoral race over the weekend, but analysts say the demographic advantage that propelled democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani to victory in the primary may not be enough to stop Andrew Cuomo's late surge as moderate and independent voters prepare to flood the polls on Election Day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/26dcff39-71da-4c39-ab2e-3264be346c67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Voters aged 18-49** outnumbered those over 50 by roughly 186,843 to 148,462 during the final weekend of early voting, reflecting Mamdani's strong Gen Z and Millennial base that helped him upset Cuomo in the Democratic primary.
* **Political analysts predict** Election Day will draw older, more moderate voters who typically skip early voting, with Gotham Polling's Stephen Graves explaining that higher overall turnout "leans more moderate and brings in the independents," which directly benefits Cuomo since he's capturing independent voters while Mamdani relies heavily on Democrats.
* **A new AtlasIntel poll** released Saturday showed Mamdani's once-commanding double-digit lead had collapsed with three days until the election, suggesting his radical rent freeze promises and progressive policies have failed to expand beyond his base.

* * *
# **Trump administration exposes massive SNAP fraud, removes 700,000 from benefits**
Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins revealed Sunday that the Trump administration uncovered[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e0516edd-5852-44e6-be6a-6a9cff199cec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[widespread fraud in the food stamp program](https://substack.com/redirect/e0516edd-5852-44e6-be6a-6a9cff199cec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and removed nearly 700,000 people from benefits while arresting 118 individuals for illegal use of government assistance since taking office.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5949b809-179d-40ea-82ed-9ec32d2adc70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Rollins disclosed** that federal investigators examining $100 billion in SNAP spending discovered thousands of cases of illegal Electronic Benefit Transfer card use after demanding data from all 50 states, with 29 states complying to expose fraud that exploded under the Biden administration when the program grew by nearly 40% in just a couple years.
* **The** **Agriculture Department 's review** uncovered egregious abuses including one individual collecting benefits simultaneously in six different states and approximately 5,000 deceased people still receiving taxpayer-funded food assistance, prompting Rollins to call the program "broken and corrupt" and vow drastic reforms to ensure only truly vulnerable Americans receive help.
* **Democrats like California Governor** Gavin Newsom are suing the Trump administration over the SNAP benefit pause that began November 1 during the government shutdown, though two federal judges ruled Friday that the administration must use a $5 billion contingency fund to continue payments despite USDA officials saying those funds are not legally available for that purpose.

* * *
# Week-ahead: Erika Kirk set to receive honor at Fox Nation's Patriots Awards
Country music star Jason Aldean and his wife Brittany will present the inaugural **[Charlie Kirk Legacy Award](https://substack.com/redirect/598e2a42-53a5-4b58-a8c2-b039851f341d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to Turning Point USA CEO Erika Kirk at Fox Nation's seventh annual Patriot Awards on Thursday in Brookville, New York, followed by a live performance featuring Aldean's patriotic anthem "Try That in a Small Town."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/598e2a42-53a5-4b58-a8c2-b039851f341d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Erika Kirk** was unanimously elected as Turning Point USA's CEO and board chair following the assassination of her husband Charlie Kirk, with the new annual award established to honor individuals who exemplify Kirk's mission of promoting faith, family and free speech.
* **Fox News host Sean Hannity** will emcee the star-studded evening celebrating veterans, first responders and everyday American patriots, with Fox News personalities including Bill Hemmer, Dana Perino, Martha MacCallum, Laura Ingraham and Jesse Watters presenting multiple awards recognizing courage and service to the nation.
* **The Patriot Awards** have become one of Fox Nation's most anticipated annual events since launching in 2019, streaming live at 8 p.m. ET on Fox Nation with an encore presentation airing later on Fox News Channel, with limited tickets still available for purchase at the Tilles Center for the Performing Arts.

body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTMxMzE3NzMS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjM0MDAzODk0NgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell Trump’s EPA to keep tracking greenhouse gases

At the request of oil and gas CEOs, Trump’s EPA is seeking to repeal the EPA’s
Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP), which requires climate polluters to
report how much they’re polluting. This move would let polluters off the hook,
making it impossible to hold them accountable, design effective climate policy,
or track progress toward cleaner energy.

The EPA is accepting public comments on this disastrous proposal for the next week— we need you to make your voice heard and tell them to keep the Greenhouse Gas
Reporting Program intact. Take action today >> https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW >> https://links.messages.lcv. Peter — Trump’s EPA is proposing yet another major polluter giveaway at the expense of people and the planet. This time, they’re planning to end the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP),
which is essential both for tracking how much climate pollution companies emit
and designing effective policies to reduce it. Without this program, scientists,
health experts, and communities nationwide will be prevented from holding Big
Polluters accountable for their contributions to climate change and harmful
health impacts. Trump’s Polluters First agenda is making communities sicker, climate disasters
worse, and solutions more expensive. Please submit your comment today — tell the Trump administration not to ban climate pollution tracking >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ The Trump EPA’s proposal would remove nearly all reporting obligations for oil
and gas companies. Our communities can’t afford to be kept in the dark as Big
Polluters continue to spew climate- and health-harming pollution into our air. What’s more, responsible companies — and their workers — who are actually
working to reduce emissions won’t be able to benefit from growing consumer
demand for products with lower carbon footprints. Without publicly available
information about companies’ emissions, consumers won’t be able to exercise
their right to choose more responsible purchases. We can’t let the Trump administration get away with yet another giveaway to Big Polluters. Tell the EPA to keep the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program intact and protect our health and our climate >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for taking action, Peter. Lisa Hoyos
Senior Director for Federal Climate and Clean Energy Solutions

subject: With food banks being stretched to their breaking point,we’re raising money right now for nine food banks and pantries in my district.
body:
While Trump is prioritizing tax breaks for billionaires over food for vulnerable families, we will keep pushing for a country where no one starves and where everyone can thrive. | | |
---
Friend, Amidst rising grocery prices and Trump’s government shutdown, people are struggling to put food on the table—particularly the children, older adults, and people with disabilities who rely on SNAP. Many federal workers haven’t been paid in over a month and are relying on food banks to feed their families. The Trump administration is slow-walking court-mandated distribution of November’s SNAP nutrition payments to states, today claiming that it will only pay half of the food assistance owed―even while the administration has access to everything that it needs to pay for food stamps in full. **Our city of Detroit is one of the poorest in the country, and with food banks being stretched to their breaking point, we’re raising money right now for nine food banks and pantries in my district.** [**Click here to donate to my Rooted in Community Leadership PAC—every dollar donated will be split evenly between the nine food banks and pantries listed The food banks and pantries we’ll distribute this funding to are: Brightmoor Connection, Brightmoor Alliance, and Gleaners in Detroit; Zaman International and Operation Refuge in Inkster; Forgotten Harvest in Oak Park; Elmwood Blessing Box in Westland; and Redford Interfaith and Eagles Helping Hands in Redford Township. Many federal workers haven’t been paid in over a month and are relying on food banks to feed their families. The Trump administration is slow-walking court-mandated distribution of November’s SNAP nutrition payments to states, today claiming that it will only pay half of the food assistance owed―even while the administration has access to everything that it needs to pay for food stamps in full. Our city of Detroit is one of the poorest in the country, and with food banks being stretched to their breaking point, we’re raising money right now for nine food banks and pantries in my district. | The food banks and pantries we’ll distribute this funding to are: Brightmoor Connection, Brightmoor Alliance, and Gleaners in Detroit; Zaman International and Operation Refuge in Inkster; Forgotten Harvest in Oak Park; Elmwood Blessing Box in Westland; and Redford Interfaith and Eagles Helping Hands in Redford Township. All are critical to addressing food insecurity in our communities and helping families survive. While Trump is prioritizing tax breaks for billionaires over food for vulnerable families, we will keep pushing for a country where no one starves and where everyone can thrive. _U.S. Marine Corporal Winsome Earle-Sears_
---
I served our nation in the US Marine Corps as an electrician & a diesel mechanic. I kept my brothers & sisters on the move and equipped to DEFEND our nation from terrorists & communists. It was during my service that I learned what real leadership and sacrifice are. _**I am forever grateful that I had the privilege to serve and defend our nation, Fellow American.**_

There's a saying: _Once a Marine, always a Marine._ Every Marine shares the same spirit of duty and service that inspired me to join--to defend our neighbors and our nation. That's why, today, I'm still serving my country.

But now, I'm fighting for my friends' and neighbors' freedoms as a civilian. In 2021, I decided to run for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia because I saw that our nation needed a strong Christian, someone who has served this great country, to step up and LEAD!

**And after a historic and hard-fought battle, my team and I won by LESS THAN 1.6% of the vote!!** Now, Democrats want me _GONE_. It doesn't matter that I'm a patriotic Marine, a strong Christian, and a mom & grandma; _the Left can 't stand me because I am a proud and unapologetic conservative!_

Now I'm running for Governor, and polls show this race could be _EVEN CLOSER_! I know my team, and I have a tough battle ahead of us. We're putting everything we've got into defending our values and showing the Left that they can't buy this election; losing simply is not an option, Fellow American.
